sourceEvidence.note: Canonical AGN-000040 outbound and bounded inbound transport contracts exist; results are limited to one authored outcome plus zero or one bounded value shape.
Client Directive completion is modeled as a dedicated third request lane rather than ToolResults or normal user input.
Agent responses carry canonical ClientDirective instances and expose a dedicated client_directive_continuation response kind without leaking internal Client Tool calls.
Registers client.terms-and-conditions as RequiresResult with authored terminal outcomes accepted, rejected, canceled, and failed and no response value.
Formal result-bearing invocation resolves the registered definition, validates/builds payload, emits ClientDirective, and persists the pending directive on the originating turn.
When Client Directive invocation tools are active, the model receives the registered directive catalog including action, response mode, usage guidance, and allowed outcomes.
The originating AgentSessionTurn durably owns pending Client Directive correlation state across requests.

Continuation restores the pending turn, enforces the dedicated request lane, validates DirectiveId, Action, authored result/value rules, rejects duplicates, runs an optional result handler, and resumes the suspended model tool call.
Result-bearing handoff emits client_directive_continuation with ClientDirectives while keeping internal ToolCallManifest continuation details off the client wire.
Executable contract tests pin the authored action, RequiresResult mode, four terminal outcomes, no-value rule, and rejection of unknown outcomes.
Approved server contract is reconciled to the implemented dotted action identity, bounded result contract, durable continuation, and internal ToolCallManifest reuse.
